description: v2 deterministic DQE policy with unrounded critical path setup slack extraction.

checks.title: Artifact manifest identity and canonical hash
checks.threshold_provenance: Immutable artifact manifest contract: manifest id, canonical SHA-256, schema version and producer identity must all agree with the TimelineEvent metadata.

checks.title: Required artifact roles present and stable
checks.threshold_provenance: Package policy: every role in required_roles must be availability=present and stability=stable; the compared value is the count of roles that are not.

checks.title: Final layout/DEF/database/netlist produced
checks.threshold_provenance: ORFS flow/Makefile `finish` target produces 6_final.gds/def/odb/v; the compared value is the count of deliverable_roles that are missing or unstable.

checks.title: Tool process exit code
checks.threshold_provenance: Execution fact carried by the Kernel TimelineEvent. Recorded, never rewritten by this package.

checks.title: Setup worst negative slack (WNS)
checks.threshold_provenance: Signoff meaning of setup slack: negative slack is a timing violation, so the check fails when WNS < 0. This is NOT the ORFS per-design regression bound.

checks.title: Critical path setup slack
checks.threshold_provenance: Unbounded critical path setup slack from OpenSTA find_timing_paths -sort_by_slack in 6_finish.rpt, preserving positive guardband slack without 0.00 truncation.

checks.title: Setup total negative slack (TNS)
checks.threshold_provenance: Aggregate severity companion to WNS; warn-only because TNS restates the same violation set.

checks.title: Setup violation path count
checks.threshold_provenance: Signoff rule: any setup-violating path (count > 0) is a timing violation.

checks.title: Hold violation path count
checks.threshold_provenance: Signoff rule: any hold-violating path (count > 0) is a timing violation.

checks.title: Max transition (slew) violation count
checks.threshold_provenance: Signoff design rule: any max transition (slew) violation (count > 0) is reported; warn-only.

checks.title: Max fanout violation count
checks.threshold_provenance: OpenSTA max_fanout design-rule check reported by the ORFS finish stage; warn-only, same family as the slew check.

checks.title: Max capacitance violation count
checks.threshold_provenance: OpenSTA max_capacitance design-rule check reported by the ORFS finish stage; warn-only, same family as the slew check.

checks.title: Detailed-route DRC violation count
checks.threshold_provenance: ORFS source: flow/designs/nangate45/gcd/rules-base.json key `detailedroute__route__drc_errors` = {value: 0, compare: '<='}. Counting rule taken from ORFS flow/util/genReport.py (count of lines containing 'violation type:') and flow/util/viewDrc.py (same marker), so an empty report means zero violations.

checks.title: ORFS log error markers
checks.threshold_provenance: ORFS source: flow/util/genReport.py REGEX_ERROR = r'^\[error ?(\w+-\d+)?\]' (case-insensitive), whose presence sets ORFS's own STATUS_RED. Anchored at line start so the word 'error' inside prose is not matched.

checks.title: ORFS log warning markers
checks.threshold_provenance: ORFS source: flow/util/genReport.py REGEX_WARNING = r'^\[warning ?(\w+-\d+)?\]' (case-insensitive). ORFS reports warnings without setting STATUS_RED, so this is warn-only here too.
